test_focus: routing verification — confirm the dreamscape/domain.py classifier + injection-style routing + seed-preference routing all work end-to-end against a real engineering-profiled agent.
tester: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context), live as the developer

experiment_design.part_1: mechanistic — 14 assertions covering classification, persistence, seed preferences, and injection style mapping for engineering / creative / research / general / empty / unknown profiles. No LLM cost.
experiment_design.part_2: small live check — 4 prompts (2 technical + 2 creative) routed through an engineering-classified agent. Verify the injection wrapper is neutral (not dreams) on every call.

qualitative_notes: Engineering-classified agent produced direct, tool-naming responses on the 2 creative prompts. The neutral wrapper did not catastrophically hurt creative output — but the Phase 14 N=140 result shows the trade-off: an engineering-classified agent's creative-prompt responses won't get the 79% treatment-win lift that a creative-classified agent gets.
Routing layer is correct end-to-end: classifier → persistence → seed preferences → injection style → middleware all produce expected outputs at every step.
Cost was negligible (~$0.004 for 4 live calls). The mechanistic part is free; that's the design goal.

feature_verdicts.injection_style_routing: sings — engineering correctly gets neutral wrapper end-to-end
feature_verdicts.creative_routing_isolation: verified — creative-prompt output from engineering agent is still usable (not catastrophic), but doesn't earn the Phase 11 / 14 treatment-win lift

known_limitations: An engineering-classified agent loses the Phase 11/14 creative-prompt lift. The trade-off is intentional — most agents focus on one domain — but agents that genuinely span domains would benefit from per-call routing.
Live check is N=4 prompts (1 per scenario); Phase 14 has the proper statistical power. P13 is a routing smoke test, not an effectiveness measurement.
verdict: READY TO MERGE — routing layer ships correctly.
next_steps: Phase 14 (now complete) gives proper statistical power on the treatment effect.
Phase 15 (running) tests engineering-craft seeds vs computing-history seeds.
